title: 女子観戦グルメ乾杯リール@PayPay Dome
scene: PayPayドームの観客席で女子3人が笑顔で観戦準備。球場グルメを手に乾杯しながら盛り上がる。応援タオルを広げてハイタッチ、自然なリアクションと笑顔が印象的。
caption: 『#野球女子』の本音トーク…！女子3人でPayPayドームへ。推しのユニで集合して、まずは絶対外せない球場グルメで乾杯🍻✨「このポテト意外と大盛り」「売店めっちゃ並んでた～！」って盛り上がってる間に、あっという間に試合スタート。やっぱり仲間と一緒だと、応援もグルメも何倍も楽しいよね。推しタオル掲げて一緒に声を出したり、写真撮ったり、気付いたらみんな笑顔☺『一緒に行く友達いなくて…』と悩んでたあの頃の自分へ、「大丈夫！仲間は絶対見つかるよ」って伝えたい。観戦の楽しみ、もっと広げていきたい人、Draftで新しい仲間作ろ！あなたはどれに共感しましたか？

prompts.kling: A group of three Japanese women in their 20s are sitting together in the stands at PayPay Dome, Fukuoka during a baseball game, smiling and chatting. They hold cups of beer and trays of stadium food, clinking drinks for a cheerful toast. The camera, appearing as a handheld smartphone, captures them laughing, eating, playfully showing their food, and waving colorful fan towels in support. Natural lighting, casual summer outfits, and a lively, authentic atmosphere. No text overlays or visible signs of AI generation.
prompts.veo: 0-5s: Three Japanese women in their 20s, wearing their favorite team's merchandise, gather at their stadium seats at PayPay Dome, laughing and taking out food and drinks for the game. 5-10s: Close-up of them clinking drinks and holding stadium food, lively reactions and casual conversations as they look into the camera, enjoying the moment together. 10-15s: The friends wave their team towels, exchange high-fives, take group selfies, and cheer for their team, all captured with a natural, handheld smartphone look that feels spontaneous and genuine.
